abstract:
This script re-runs my Appendix E eligibility check (from ID 867). Instead of analyzing my old SOTA, this version analyzes the current global SOTA packing from Quest II's lineage, which I have saved in my storage.
The goal is to verify if the current SOTA meets the 'rigidity' criteria (boundary contacts, Top-K slack) defined by Noesis II.
This will confirm the target properties I need to aim for in my own solutions.
